$comment: Todo 13 same-value allow-list. A ko key whose value legitimately equals its en source lives here with a reason (identifiers, OLGA keywords, variable codes, units, file names, value+unit templates, language autonyms). Translate the key and the entry must be removed (the completeness test fails on stale entries).

allow.env.cap.multiflash: Product name of the third-party PVT package; proper noun shown in both languages.
allow.findings.evidenceSha: Hash-fragment template (' · sha {sha}'); no translatable words.
allow.flowpath.mmRange: Value + mm unit template; identical by construction.
allow.flowpath.mmSingle: Value + mm unit template; identical by construction.
allow.flowpath.pointMeters: Value + m unit template; identical by construction.
allow.language.english: Language autonym in the language picker; each language names itself.
allow.language.korean: Language autonym in the language picker; each language names itself.
allow.language.title: Bilingual section title ('언어 / Language') by design.
allow.profile.yAxis: Variable-code + unit template; contents come from data.
allow.results.readout: Symbol readout template (t=… s · …); no translatable words.
allow.run.outputMeta: Size + SHA-256 template; contents come from data.
allow.run.reason.selectedEngine: Engine-name template ('{engine}.'); contents come from data.
allow.run.runtimeFull: Proper-noun template ('OLGA {version} · {kind}'); kind is translated separately.
allow.run.simHours: Value + h/s unit symbols; never translated.
allow.run.simMinutes: Value + min/s unit symbols; never translated.
allow.run.simSeconds: Value + s unit symbol; never translated.
allow.settings.diagnosticsBundleReady: Path + size template ('{path} ({size})'); no translatable words.
allow.saveas.recoveryMeta: Filename + translated backup word + time template; no fixed English words.
allow.shell.localeEn: Locale code label for the EN toggle; a code, not copy.
allow.tool.ariaPlain: Name + state template; contents come from data.
allow.runtime.versionLabel: Version template ('OLGA {version}'); contents come from data.
